findings.slide: Whole lesson (build_log trimmed_time; Observe cell slides, Four ideas to clear up, Model slides)
findings.problem: The 20-minute trim was not spread fairly. Each cell gets 3-4 minutes against the SoW's 6, a loss of about 40-50%. The Observe phase as a whole drops from about 40 minutes (five cells, stomata comparison, cold-call) to 26. The mini-lecture drops from 10 minutes to 6, a loss of 40%. The Model phase gets 6 minutes for drawing and labelling five cells with arrows, against the SoW's 12 for the plant side alone. The build_log says Observe and Model Building lose 'slightly more than a quarter', which understates the cuts and does not mention the mini-lecture cut. Predict keeps nearly its full SoW time, and the fixed slides total 4 minutes plus the 2-minute summary.
findings.fix: Spread the loss more evenly. Take time from the fixed slides, from the 2-minute summary (set it as homework) and from the small gaps in Predict. Give each cell about 4 minutes, the mini-lecture 8 and the plant-side model 8-9. Report the true per-phase losses in build_log.

findings.slide: Explain your cell: Claim, Evidence, Reasoning
findings.problem: The SoW has each group choose a cell, prepare a 90-second CER explanation, and present, with the class giving peer feedback after every presentation. The deck allows 5 minutes for preparation and all presentations. For a class of 40 or more (10 or more groups), only 2-3 presentations fit. The note 'If time runs out, tell groups you will hear the other cells next lesson' quietly changes the lesson, because the SoW's peer-feedback protocol and 'after all presentations' consolidation no longer apply to the whole class.
findings.fix: Give this slide 8-10 minutes, taken from Observe and Model time. Say in the notes how many presentations a large class can hear (for example one group per cell, five in all, about 8 minutes). Log this in build_log as a trim.

findings.problem: The first goal, 'Describe the structure of five specialised plant cells', is shown before Predict. It tells learners that plant cells do specialise and that there are five of them, which is the answer to the Predict question. The key words (Specialised cell) have the same effect. The goals are deck wording, not the SoW's.
findings.fix: Phrase the goals as questions or neutral aims, for example 'Compare cells from different parts of a plant' and 'Decide whether shape fits job'. Leave out 'five' and 'specialised' until after Predict.

findings.problem: The first SAY line is not natural speech: 'Why would a cell that is empty inside be good for carrying water? Then we call this idea specialisation.' The SAY lines run together without showing which line belongs to which tile, and the xylem tile asks 'Why do xylem cells die to work?' before the 'Is the xylem vessel alive?' misconception check. That gives away the point the SoW wants learners to be probed on.
findings.fix: Rewrite the SAY lines as four separate question-then-explanation pairs, one per tile. Replace the opening line with 'Why would a hollow tube be good for carrying water?' Reword the tile to something less leading, such as 'How does a cell with nothing inside carry water?'

findings.problem: The githeri and sukuma wiki plate is shown with the question 'What does the plant give to the animal side?'. The picture of food points to the answer before learners think. The SoW uses the githeri line only as the teacher's closing remark.
findings.fix: Remove the illustration from this slide and keep the githeri line as the spoken close. Or show the picture only after the partner share.

findings.slide: Do plant cells specialise too? / Match the cards
findings.problem: The legume allergy check and hand washing sit as the last 'do' item on the first Predict slide, mixed with other notes. The SoW also wants microscope slides stored away before the card activity, but that reminder is only in Predict and before_class, not on the Match the cards slide. There is no Safety slide, and the glance does not mention allergy.
findings.fix: Put the allergy and hand-washing line first in the Predict notes. Add 'Check that microscope slides are stored away' to the Match the cards notes. Add a one-line safety item to the glance materials.

findings.slide: Share with your partner / Model: Share your bridge arrow (for the SoW owner)
findings.problem: The SoW is inconsistent in two places, and the build_log flags neither. The partner share is '2 minutes' in the learner experience but '1 minute' in the teacher moves (the deck uses 1). The overview says Lesson 9 bridges 'toward the upcoming lessons on plant nutrition and transport', but Lesson 10 is cell organisation, and the deck's model prediction ('cells join together') points to Lesson 10.
findings.fix: Add build_log entries so the SoW owner can fix both. Keep the deck following the SoW wording.

build_log.sow_says: Observe: about 6 minutes per cell for five cells (about 30 minutes) plus the Turkana/Kericho comparison and a 3-learner cold-call. Explain: 8-minute card match, 90-second CER presentations, 10-minute mini-lecture, written check and prediction review. DQB: 2 minutes of slips plus a 4-minute discussion. Model Building: 12 minutes plus cold-calls. SoW total is about 100 minutes (estimated, because some parts have no stated time).
build_log.deck_does: Fits 80 minutes: Predict 8, Observe 26, Explain 25, Driving Question Board 5, Model Building 12, with 1 minute for the unit map, 1 for goals and 2 for the Summary Table. Cells take 3-4 minutes each instead of 6. The mini-lecture is 6 minutes instead of 10. The Driving Question Board discussion is 3 minutes instead of 4.
build_log.why: The SoW activities add up to more than 80 minutes. Times were cut across all phases without removing any activity. Observe and Model Building lose slightly more than a quarter, so the teacher checker should confirm the pace is realistic.

build_log.sow_says: Lesson 9 substrand: 'Sub-Strand 1.1: Cell Structure'. The unit says 'Sub-Strand 1.3: Cell Structure and Specialisation'.
build_log.deck_does: Uses the lesson's own sub-strand name (Cell Structure) and does not print a sub-strand number.
build_log.why: The unit label does not match the sub-strand number. The SoW owner should check which is correct.

build_log.sow_says: 'A Form 1 student in Nairobi cuts their finger while slicing onions' (anchoring phenomenon)
build_log.deck_does: Does not use the phrase on these slides. Refers to 'the cut finger'.
build_log.why: CBE uses Grade 10, not Form 1. The SoW owner should update the phenomenon text.

build_log.sow_says: Storyline: 'guard cells (control stomatal opening — relevant to water loss in dry Turkana vs. humid Kisumu)'. Lesson 9 uses 'dry Turkana vs. humid Kericho'.
build_log.deck_does: Uses Kericho, as in the Lesson 9 framework and context cards.
build_log.why: The two documents name different humid places. The SoW owner should pick one.

build_log.sow_says: 'We have seen that blood cells specialise — platelets are flat and sticky, red blood cells are disc-shaped.' Lesson 8 covers red blood cells, white blood cells, nerve, sperm and muscle cells.
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the wording in the teacher notes as the SoW says it.
build_log.why: Platelets are not one of the five cells in Lesson 8, so the earlier lesson and this prompt do not match. Platelets are also cell fragments, not whole cells. The SoW owner should check.

build_log.sow_says: 'Remember the fibroblast — it had lots of rough ER to make collagen.'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the line in the notes as written.
build_log.why: The Lesson 8 overview does not include fibroblasts or rough ER, and the Lesson 5 overview only briefly mentions them. Learners may not remember this cell. The SoW owner should check where fibroblasts were taught.

build_log.sow_says: 'a stomatal image from a maize leaf collected in dry Turkana (stomata mostly closed) vs. a tea leaf from humid Kericho (stomata mostly open)'
build_log.deck_does: The slide names the two places. The notes tell the teacher to supply the two images.
build_log.why: No images or ARES resource are provided for these. No images were invented.

build_log.sow_says: 'projects or draws (in sequence) five specialised plant cells'; 'where available, prepared microscope slides'
build_log.deck_does: Uses the diagram templates for the five cells. Prepared slides are not listed anywhere, so they are not mentioned on the slides.
build_log.why: The SoW gives no list of slides, materials or quantities. The deck relies on the drawings.

build_log.sow_says: '5 Function Cards (e.g., ...Absorbs water and mineral salts from the soil around the bean seedling's roots) and 5 Context/Location Cards (e.g., 'Found in the outer layer of roots, just behind the root tip' or 'Found in leaves — more open in humid Kericho, more closed in dry Turkana')'
build_log.deck_does: Completes the set. Function cards: F1 Carries water up the plant (xylem). F2 Makes food by photosynthesis (palisade). F3 Absorbs water and mineral salts from the soil (root hair). F4 Opens and closes the stoma (guard cells). F5 Carries sugars around the plant (phloem). Place cards: C1 Roots, stem, leaf veins; beside a companion cell (phloem). C2 Outer layer of roots, just behind the tip (root hair). C3 Leaves: more open in humid Kericho, more closed in dry Turkana (guard cells). C4 Just below the upper surface of the leaf (palisade). C5 Roots, stem, leaf veins; no end walls (xylem).
build_log.why: The SoW names only some cards, so the set was completed to 5 function and 5 place cards. The teacher should check each card and its answer.

build_log.sow_says: '(a) why xylem cells die to become functional, (b) the role of lignin in xylem walls, (c) how the perforated sieve plates of phloem allow sugar to flow between cells, and (d) the link between palisade cell chloroplast density and photosynthesis rate'
build_log.deck_does: The science note says that xylem vessels develop from living cells, their contents break down and lignin strengthens the wall, and that sieve plates are the perforated end walls of sieve tube elements. The xylem slide note says lignin makes the wall strong.
build_log.why: These are established textbook facts the SoW does not state. The teacher should verify them.

build_log.sow_says: 'stomata mostly closed' in dry Turkana and 'mostly open' in humid Kericho
build_log.deck_does: The answer key says guard cells close the stomata in dry places to reduce water loss and open them more in humid places.
build_log.why: This is an established textbook idea that links the SoW's observation to function. The teacher should verify it.

build_log.sow_says: 'every meal of githeri or sukuma wiki that feeds our body's repair workers'
build_log.deck_does: Adds a new illustration (githeri_sukuma_plate) of a Kenyan plate of githeri and sukuma wiki. It has no people or writing.
build_log.why: This sets the scene for the bridge arrow. The illustration needs to be generated and checked.

build_log.sow_says: No ARES resources are named in the lesson plan.
build_log.deck_does: No resource is placed on any Part A slide. Part B decides the match notes for the listed resource keys.
build_log.why: None of the listed keys fits a specific Part A moment well, and some could give away answers before learners record their own work.

build_log.sow_says: Lesson 9 safetyNotes: 'No sharp instruments or chemicals are used in this lesson. If fresh bean seedlings are handled, learners should wash hands after. Ensure no learner has a legume allergy.'
build_log.deck_does: Treats the lesson as not a practical, so there is no Safety slide (safety minutes 0). The seedling, allergy and slide-storage points are in the Predict slide notes.
build_log.why: The lesson uses diagrams and cards only. The teacher checker should confirm that no Safety slide is needed.

build_log.sow_says: 'Learners observe the class bean seedling (growing since Lesson 1)' and 'the bean seedling that has been growing since Lesson 1 is now visibly differentiated'
build_log.deck_does: Uses the bean seedling as the SoW says. The teacher is told to display it.
build_log.why: The Lesson 1 overview does not mention starting a bean seedling. The SoW owner should add this to Lesson 1 or change the wording.

build_log.sow_says: Only the card set (15 cards per group of four) and two sticky notes per learner are given with numbers.
build_log.deck_does: The glance materials list gives quantities only where the SoW does. Other items have none.
build_log.why: The SoW gives no quantities for the seedling, images, notebooks, name cards or models, and no number of groups.

build_log.sow_says: 'five key specialised plant cells' shown as 'detailed diagrams and (where available) prepared microscope slides or a teacher-led projected image set'
build_log.deck_does: The deck uses the five diagram templates. It does not mention prepared slides.
build_log.why: No slide list, source or ARES resource is given for prepared slides or an image set.

build_log.sow_says: No ARES resources are named in the lesson plan. Eight keys are listed in the input.
build_log.deck_does: Marks observe.reading, explain.video and model.reading as preview_first. The other five are do_not_use. No resource is placed on any slide.
build_log.why: All eight resources cover general cell structure, not specialised plant cells. Teacher must preview any resource before use. Titles and sources were taken from the input only.

build_log.sow_says: Lesson titles in the SoW are long, with subtitles.
build_log.deck_does: Unit map titles use only words from each lesson's own SoW title, up to 6 words. Lesson 12 is shown as 'The Healing Cut Fully Explained'. Lesson 6 is shown as 'Observing Onion Epidermal Cells'.
build_log.why: This keeps the unit map short without inventing names.

build_log.sow_says: Learning outcomes for the sub-strand include 'explain the relationship between the structure and function of specialised cells'.
build_log.deck_does: Key words are only general ones: Specialised cell, Structure, Function, Evidence. No cell names are used.
build_log.why: Structure names such as xylem or guard cells are introduced on the observe slides and must not appear before Predict.
